d: Distance past the point overhead when the cone arrives
f: Frequency: observed, in the data table; emitted, in the formula for f′
h: Height of the flight above the observer
t: Time since a crest was emitted
theta: Angle: in f′, between the source's velocity and the line to the observer; for the Mach cone, its half angle
theta_c: Half angle of the Mach cone
